description: Behavioural regression scenarios; run with the named skill and stated images. Assertions require judging executed work, not matching skill text. Static validation does not run these scenarios.

cases.prompt: Review six thumbnails where a cream device sits centred on a pale blue-grey ground, in cards 300 px wide. Why do they feel plain?
assertions: Runs the script or says why it could not, and quotes the measured value jump.
Names the lack of separation and the shared ground and crop across neighbours.
Proposes different shots across the set instead of one uniform new ground.

cases.prompt: Review this varied set of product shots at 300 px, where most already work.
assertions: Says what to leave alone and does not invent failures.

cases.prompt: Review portfolio cards that each shrink a whole website screenshot into a browser frame.
assertions: Names boxed and proposes cropping into one surface, with a ground drawn from each project.
Does not give Blender instructions for a website.

cases.prompt: Apply the chosen orange shot to the feed thumbnail.
assertions: Changes only the feed thumbnail and checks it at real size in both themes.
Asks before touching any other page that uses the old image.

cases.prompt: Direct a hero shot for a new device; a Blender scene exists.
assertions: Starts from one sentence the shot must say.
Renders a low-sample sheet of different setups, not variations of one idea, and says which are worse.
Lets the user choose from images before a final render.
